claim.claim-text: 1. A lighting apparatus, comprising: a support rod having a mounting end and a supporting end that are axially opposite to each other; a movable rod having a first connecting end and a second connecting end that are axially opposite to each other, wherein the first connecting end is pivotally connected to the mounting end, and when the first connecting end pivots relative to the mounting end, an included angle between the movable rod and the support rod changes, and the movable rod is pivotable to be side-by-side and adjacent to the support rod; and a lamp head connected to the second connecting end, the lamp head comprising a lamp housing and a light source connected to the lamp housing, wherein the lamp housing is configured to clasp onto the supporting end when the movable rod and the support rod are in a side-by-side and adjacent posture.

2. The lighting apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the movable rod comprises a fixed rod and a telescopic rod, wherein the first connecting end of the fixed rod is pivotally connected to the mounting end, the second connecting end of the telescopic rod is connected to the lamp housing, and the telescopic rod is telescopically sleeved with the fixed rod, enabling the movable rod to extend or retract; wherein when the movable rod and the support rod are in the side-by-side and adjacent posture, the lamp housing is configured to clasp onto a bottom portion of the supporting end by retracting the movable rod.

3. The lighting apparatus according to claim 2, wherein the support rod comprises a rod body and a plurality of legs, wherein two axially opposite ends of the rod body correspond to the supporting end and the mounting end, respectively; the legs have a pivoting end and a fixing end that are axially opposite to each other, wherein the pivoting end is pivotally connected to a side periphery of the rod body, and when the pivoting end pivots outwardly relative to the rod body, a plurality of the fixing ends are configured to switch from a retracted state wherein the fixing ends are positioned proximate to each other to a deployed state wherein the fixing ends are spaced apart from each other; and when the plurality of the fixing ends are in the retracted state, the lamp housing is configured to simultaneously clasp onto the bottom portion of the supporting end and bottom portions of the plurality of the fixing ends when the movable rod and the support rod are in the side-by-side and adjacent posture.

4. The lighting apparatus according to claim 3, wherein the lamp housing is provided with a mounting groove, wherein the bottom portions of the plurality of the fixing ends are configured to be simultaneously fitted into the mounting groove to be clasped with the lamp housing.

5. The lighting apparatus according to claim 3, wherein the fixing end of each of the legs is provided with a magnet, and the fixing end is configured to be magnetically attracted to the lamp head via the magnet.

6. The lighting apparatus according to claim 3, wherein the lamp housing is provided with a mounting groove, the fixing end of each of the legs is provided with a magnet, and the bottom portions of the plurality of the fixing ends are configured to be simultaneously fitted into the mounting groove to be clasped with the lamp housing, and simultaneously, the fixing end is magnetically attracted to the lamp head via the magnet.

7. The lighting apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the lamp head is pivotally connected to the second connecting end to achieve pivoting of the lamp head; wherein when the movable rod and the support rod are in the side-by-side and adjacent posture, the lamp housing is configured to clasp onto a bottom portion of the supporting end by pivoting the lamp head.

8. The lighting apparatus according to claim 7, wherein the support rod comprises a rod body and a plurality of legs, wherein two axially opposite ends of the rod body correspond to the supporting end and the mounting end, respectively; the legs have a pivoting end and a fixing end that are axially opposite to each other, wherein the pivoting end is pivotally connected to a side periphery of the rod body, and when the pivoting end pivots outwardly relative to the rod body, a plurality of the fixing ends are configured to switch from a retracted state wherein the fixing ends are positioned proximate to each other to a deployed state wherein the fixing ends are spaced apart from each other; and when the plurality of the fixing ends are in the retracted state, the lamp housing is configured to simultaneously clasp onto the bottom portion of the supporting end and bottom portions of the plurality of the fixing ends when the movable rod and the support rod are in the side-by-side and adjacent posture.

9. The lighting apparatus according to claim 8, wherein the lamp housing is provided with a mounting groove, wherein the bottom portions of the plurality of the fixing ends are configured to be simultaneously fitted into the mounting groove to be clasped with the lamp housing.

10. The lighting apparatus according to claim 8, wherein the fixing end of each of the legs is provided with a magnet, and the fixing end is configured to be magnetically attracted to the lamp head via the magnet.

11. The lighting apparatus according to claim 8, wherein the lamp housing is provided with a mounting groove, the fixing end of each of the legs is provided with a magnet, and the bottom portions of the plurality of the fixing ends are configured to be simultaneously fitted into the mounting groove to be clasped with the lamp housing, and simultaneously, the fixing end is magnetically attracted to the lamp head via the magnet.

12. The lighting apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the lamp housing is provided with a mounting groove, wherein a bottom portion of the supporting end is configured to be fitted into the mounting groove to be clasped with the lamp housing.

13. The lighting apparatus according to claim 1, wherein at the second connecting end, the lamp head is configured to rotate circumferentially about a first rotation axis, and to perform a pivoting movement about a second rotation axis, wherein the first rotation axis is parallel to an axis of the second connecting end and perpendicular to the second rotation axis; the lamp housing has a first end face and a second end face that are oppositely disposed; by means of the circumferential rotation and the pivoting movement of the lamp head, the lamp head is configured to clasp onto the supporting end, and the lamp housing is configured to selectively enable the first end face to clasp onto the supporting end, or enable the second end face to clasp onto the supporting end; the light source comprises a first illumination lamp, and light from the first illumination lamp is emitted through the first end face.

14. The lighting apparatus according to claim 13, wherein the light source further comprises a second illumination lamp disposed within the lamp housing, wherein light from the second illumination lamp is emitted through the second end face; wherein a luminous parameter of the first illumination lamp is different from a luminous parameter of the second illumination lamp, the luminous parameter comprising at least one of luminous intensity, luminous flux, illuminance, luminance, luminous efficacy, and color temperature.
15. The lighting apparatus according to claim 14, wherein the first illumination lamp is a spot lamp, and the second illumination lamp is a flood lamp.

16. The lighting apparatus according to claim 14, wherein the first end face and the second end face are both provided with a mounting groove, a bottom wall of the mounting groove is light-transmissive, and light from the first illumination lamp and light from the second illumination lamp are both emitted through the bottom wall of the mounting groove; and when the lamp housing clasps onto the supporting end, a bottom portion of the supporting end is fitted into the mounting groove.

17. The lighting apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the movable rod is further configured to rotate circumferentially about a central axis of the support rod, and wherein the movable rod, after being rotated circumferentially to an arbitrary angular orientation, is pivotable relative to the support rod to the side-by-side and adjacent posture, and the lamp head clasps onto the supporting end.

18. The lighting apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the movable rod is pivotable relative to the support rod about a third rotation axis; one of the first connecting end and the mounting end is connected with an adapter, and a side periphery of the other one of the first connecting end and the mounting end is provided with a first lug and a second lug that are spaced apart and opposite to each other, wherein the third rotation axis passes through the first lug, the adapter, and the second lug in sequence; a clearance region is formed between the first lug and the second lug, the clearance region allowing for pivoting of the adapter.

19. The lighting apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the lighting apparatus further comprises a battery and a conductive wire, the battery being disposed within the support rod, the conductive wire being disposed within the movable rod and the support rod, and the light source is electrically connected to the battery via the conductive wire.
20. The lighting apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the lamp head and the movable rod are detachably connected.
